chunks: He (the Imam, peace be upon him) wrote this epistle to his companions and commanded them to study it, reflect upon it, observe it faithfully, and act upon it. They would place it in the prayer niches of their homes, and whenever they finished the prayer, they would review it.

He (al-Kulayni) said: And Hasan ibn Muhammad narrated to me, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Malik al-Kufi, from al-Qasim ibn al-Rabi' al-Sahhaf, from Ismail ibn Makhled al-Sarraj, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said: This epistle issued from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) to his companions.
In the Name of Allah, the All-Beneficent, the All-Merciful. Now, to proceed (Amma ba'd):

Ask your Lord for well-being. You must observe calmness, dignity, and tranquility. You must observe modesty and restrain yourselves from what the righteous before you restrained themselves from. You must treat the people of falsehood kindly — bear their harm patiently and beware of their contentiousness. Keep your tongues and your hands, and you will be with us just as your forefathers were with the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family). Keep away from what Allah has forbidden — a commandment I have issued to you along with His command. You must observe silence, except in what benefits you in your Hereafter and earns you reward. Increase in saying 'La ilaha illa Allah' and in reciting the Quran. Make the pillars of your prayer in the night. Speak only what is good, for your salvation lies in what is good for you from your Lord — and that is all I command you, and this is your duty. Do not be among those who mix the truth with falsehood, nor among those who add and innovate in the religion. Your salvation is in having good character and good conduct with the people, and that you follow the path of the truthful before you. Know that the one who fears Allah and has taqwa — Allah will find a way out for him and will provide for him from where he does not expect.

Beware of what Allah has forbidden you from committing. You must maintain silence except in what will benefit you from the affairs of your Hereafter and earn you reward. Increase in tahlil (saying la ilaha illa Allah), taqdis (sanctification), tasbih (glorification), praise of Allah, and humble supplication to Him. And beware of engaging in vain and false talk and talk that does not benefit you, for slipping the tongue into what Allah dislikes and what He forbids brings ruin to the servant before Allah, and incurs His wrath, deafness, blindness, and muteness — which Allah will afflict him with on the Day of Resurrection. And you will become as Allah said: 'Deaf, dumb, blind — they will not return.' That is, they will not speak and no permission will be given to them to offer excuses.

And He commanded you to restrain your tongues from false speech, slander, sin, and transgression. For if you restrain your tongues from what Allah dislikes, that will be better for you with your Lord. For indeed the slipping of the tongue in what Allah dislikes and what He forbids is ruin for the servant before Allah, and wrath from Allah, and deafness, blindness, and muteness that Allah will cause him to inherit on the Day of Resurrection.

So increase your glorification of Allah and your praise of Him, and supplicate to Allah profusely and with humility for He loves those among His believing servants who call upon Him. He has promised those who call upon Him that He will answer them, and He has called those who disdain His worship — and worship is du'a — as arrogant ones. And beware of associating any partner with Allah, great or small.

And if they deny you — for the prophets before you were denied, yet they were patient in the face of denial and harm. So beware of what the People of Knowledge abandoned when they turned away from the Imams of guidance and those in authority from the family of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family). And know that the people of knowledge who have been saved are those who hold fast to the guidance of the Imams of Guidance, and who are the masters of knowledge. Whoever from among the people of ijtihad abandons the fountains of knowledge and follows their own opinions and analogies has gone astray — and all straying leads to the Fire.

O you blessed and flourishing community! Allah has completed for you what He has given you of good. Know that no servant of Allah has been honored with the truth except through the Imams of guidance from the family of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family). They are the People of Remembrance whom Allah commanded to be asked — for they are the bearers of the knowledge of the Prophets and Messengers. The Imams are the authorized inheritors of that knowledge, and they are who Allah has caused to inherit the Book and the wisdom.

Those who disdain to ask them and follow their own opinions and analogies have gone astray. Allah has honored you with the truth and made you see it clearly. And those who abandon the fountains of knowledge — the Imams of guidance — and follow the opinions of those who reason by analogy, have made permissible many things that are unlawful. That is the root and fruit of their errant opinions.

Allah's Messenger (peace be upon him and his family) is sufficient for us — we are able to take from what the community agreed upon during the lifetime of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) and after his demise and after his covenant which he entrusted to us. For those who have disagreed with the Imams of guidance have gone astray by abandoning what was with the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) during his life, after his passage and after his covenant which he entrusted to us (the Imams).

And it is not possible for us to take from anyone who follows his own desires and opinions and analogies. The enemy of Allah can testify to the falsehood on behalf of the enemy of Allah — that is the origin of the fruits of their errant opinions. They have declared many impermissible things as permissible by their own analogies, just as they declared many permissible things as impermissible. And Allah, the Exalted, says — and His word is the truth: 'We were able to compel this Messenger...' Has you not heard what Allah the Exalted has Mentioned of the qualities of following the Imams of guidance, and they are the Believers?

And he (the Imam, peace be upon him) said: Abandon raising your hands in prayer except once — when the prayer is opened. For the people have already recognized you by this. So leave the raising of hands — for indeed it is something that will make you conspicuous.

Increase in supplicating to Allah, for Allah loves among His believing servants those who call upon Him. And He has promised those who call upon Him that He will answer them, and He has called those who disdain His worship arrogant ones — and worship is du'a (supplication). Know that the continuation of deeds in following the footsteps and the Sunnah, even if they be little, is more pleasing to Allah and more beneficial with Him in rewards than the struggle in innovation and desires. For indeed following desires and following innovations without guidance from Allah is misguidance, and every misguidance is heresy, and every heretic is in the Fire. And nothing can be achieved of the good with Allah except through obedience to Him, patience, and contentment — for patience and contentment are from obedience to Allah.

Know that no servant from the servants of Allah has believed until he is pleased with Allah regarding whatever Allah has done for him, and with what he has done for Allah in accordance with what He likes and dislikes. And Allah does not deal with the one who is patient and pleased with Allah except in that which is deserving and that which is better for him — from what he likes or dislikes.

And it is for you to attend constantly to prayers and to the middle prayer and stand up truly obedient to Allah, just as Allah has commanded the Believers in His Book which is before you [Quran 2:238].

O you community for whom Allah has protected their affairs! It is for you to follow the footsteps of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and his Sunnah, and the footsteps of the Imams of Guidance from the People of the Household of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) from after him, and their Sunnah. So the one who takes to that has been guided, and the one who avoided that and abandoned it went astray — for they are the ones for whom Allah commanded obedience and their wilayah.

And our father the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The continuation upon the deeds in the following of the footsteps and the Sunnah, even though they may be little, is more pleasing to Allah and beneficial with Him in Rewards, than the struggle in heresy and desires.' Indeed following desires and following innovations without Guidance from Allah is misguidance, and every misguidance is heresy, and every heretic will be in the Fire.

And our forefather the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Allah commanded me to love the poor among Muslims.' And know that the one who belittles anyone from the Muslims will meet Allah with hatred toward him. Fear Allah regarding your brothers who are poor Muslims, for they have a right over you that you love them. Allah commanded His Messenger to love them.

Beware of arrogance and pride — for arrogance is the robe of Allah Mighty and Majestic, and whoever disputes with Allah over His robe, Allah will humiliate him and disgrace him on the Day of Judgment.

Beware of injustice — for the one who is unjust, Allah will turn his injustice against himself and make His help go to the one who was wronged. Beware of envy among yourselves — for disbelief originates in envy. Beware of aiding against an oppressed Muslim — for his supplication against you will be answered. Help each other, for helping a Muslim is greater in reward than a month of fasting and i'tikaf in the Sacred Mosque.

Beware of creating hardship for a Muslim brother who owes you when he is insolvent — for the considerate one will be shaded by Allah on the Day when there is no shade except His shade.

Beware of withholding the Rights of Allah before you — for the one who hastens in giving the Rights of Allah, Allah will hasten the multiplication of good for him. Give to Allah the right from what He has granted you, that He may purify the remainder for you.

He (the Imam, peace be upon him) said: Fear Allah, O community, if you could, and do not be an embarrassment for the Imam — for the one who causes embarrassment for the Imam is the one who discredits the righteous people, those who follow the Imam of the Muslims for his virtues, those patient in fulfilling his rights, those who have recognized his sanctity. And know that the one who descends to that level with respect to the Imam will embarrass the Imam by associating himself with him — he would curse the righteous people and his curse against them is (counted as) a curse of the enemies of Allah, as the Imam converts that curse into Mercy from Allah upon them. And know, O community, that the Sunnah from Allah has flowed within the righteous ones before.

He (the Imam) said: The one who wishes to meet Allah as a true Believer — truly and surely — so he should befriend Allah, and His Messenger, and those who believed (the Imams, peace be upon them), and should distance himself from their enemies, and accept whatever that has reached him of their virtues — for their virtues cannot be comprehended by the Angels of Proximity or the Messenger Prophets, but some among them. Have you not heard what Allah has Mentioned of the virtues of following the Imams of Guidance, and they are the Believers? He said: 'And whoever obeys Allah and the Messenger, these are with those upon whom Allah has bestowed favors from among the prophets and the truthful and the martyrs and the good, and a goodly company are they!' [4:69].

This is just one perspective from the perspectives of the virtues of following the Imams, so how can others comprehend them and their virtues? And the one who wishes that Allah should complete for him his faith and he becomes a devout and true Believer, he should fulfill to Allah His Conditions which He has Placed upon the Believers: the wilayah along with the wilayah of His Messenger and the wilayah of the Imams of the Believers. He should establish the Prayer, and give the Zakat, and give to Allah goodly loans, and avoid the immoralities both openly and discreetly. There does not remain anything from the detail of what Allah has Prohibited except that it is included in its entirety in His Statement. So the one who makes it to be his religion in what is between himself and Allah, being sincere to Allah, and does not authorize for himself to ignore anything from this, is in the Sight of Allah in His Triumphant Party, and he is from the true Believers.

He (the Imam) said: And upon you is obedience to your Lord to the extent of your ability, for Allah is your Lord. And know that Islam is submission, and submission is Islam. So whoever submits has Islam, and whoever does not submit has no Islam. And whoever wishes to do himself a favor, let him obey Allah — for whoever obeys Allah has done himself a favor. And beware of disobeying Allah if you are able. Whoever violates by disobeying Allah has done himself a disfavor, and there is no station between favor and disfavor. For those who have done a favor in the Sight of their Lord is Paradise, and for those who have transgressed is the Fire. So know that you must be obedient to Allah and avoid disobeying Him. Know that no one is needless of Allah from His creatures — not the Angels of Proximity, nor the Messenger Prophets, nor anyone else. So whoever wishes to benefit from the intercession of the intercessors in the Presence of Allah should seek to please Allah. And know that no creature of Allah can achieve the Pleasure of Allah except through obedience to Him, and obedience to His Messenger, and obedience to the Masters of Command from the progeny of Muhammad, and that disobedience to them is disobedience to Allah.

And do not deny their virtues, whether great or small. Know that the deniers are liars, they are the hypocrites — and Allah Mighty and Majestic said about the hypocrites, and His words are the truth: 'Surely the hypocrites are in the lowest stage of the fire and you shall not find a helper for them' [4:145].

Let no one from among you whom Allah has necessitated upon his heart obedience to Him and humility before Him fear anyone from the people from whom Allah has removed the qualities of truth. For those from whom Allah has not made the qualities of truth deserving are the hypocrites — these are the Satans among the humans and the Jinn. And it is the Satans among the humans that trick, and plot, and deceive, and whisper among each other, attempting to divert the people of truth from what Allah has honored them with.

Do not let them scare you, and do not let them repulse you from consideration of the truth. Repel evil with good in what is between you and them, seeking thereby the pleasure of your Lord through obedience to Him. It is not permissible for you to display to them the Principles of the Religion of Allah, for they will hear something from you, become hostile toward you, and strive for your destruction.

Do not expose your religion and your Imams to the people of falsehood. Do not descend to the level of the people of falsehood — for Allah did not make the people of falsehood deserving of the status He has for the people of truth. 'Shall We treat those who believe and work deeds of righteousness the same as those who do mischief on earth? Shall We treat those who guard against evil the same as those who turn aside from the right?' [38:28]. Love for Allah's sake those who share your qualities, and hate for Allah's sake those who oppose you. And extend your counsel and advice to those who possess your qualities.

He (the Imam, peace be upon him) said: If Allah had created a servant originally in the original creation as a Believer, he will never die until Allah makes him detest the evil and he distances himself from it. And the one whom Allah makes to detest the evil and distances himself from it — Allah will cure him of the arrogance and forcefulness that had entered into him. So his nature becomes gentle, and his morals beautiful, and his face radiant, and the reverence of Islam comes upon him with tranquility and humility. He restrains himself from the Prohibitions of Allah and avoids His harshness. And Allah grants him the sustenance of cordiality with people, mixing with them, and avoidance of cutting off from them and rivalries.

However, if Allah had created a servant originally in the original creation as a disbeliever, he will never die until he loves evil and draws near to it. So when evil becomes beloved to him and he draws near to it, he falls into disbelief and forcefulness. His heart hardens, his morals deteriorate, his face darkens, his immorality becomes manifest, his shame diminishes, Allah uncovers his veil, and he rides upon the prohibitions. He never ceases from these tendencies and rides upon disobedience to Allah, hates to obey Him, and hates the obedient ones.

So the condition of the Believer and the condition of the disbeliever are in contradiction. Ask Allah for health and seek it from Him; there is no might nor strength except through Allah.

Observe patience upon the afflictions in the world if afflictions befall you, and intensify your obedience to Allah, and His wilayah, and the wilayah of those He has commanded — that is the better outcome with Allah in the Hereafter than the kingdom of the world, even if its bounties, flowers, and affluence be prolonged in disobedience to Allah.

And Allah commanded the wilayah of the Imams whom Allah has named in His Book in His Statement: 'And We made them Imams who guided (people) by Our command' [21:73] — and they are the ones for whom Allah has commanded the wilayah and obedience. And those whom Allah has forbidden to be in their wilayah are the imams of misguidance.

So ponder over the stories Allah has related to you in His Book of the trials by which He tested His Prophets and the Believers who followed them. Then ask Allah to grant you patience upon affliction in ease and hardship.

And beware of debating with the people of falsehood. And it is for you to follow the guidance of the righteous ones, their dignified manners, their tranquility, their forbearance, their humility, and their distancing themselves from the Prohibitions of Allah, and their truthfulness, and their loyalty, and their struggle for the sake of Allah in the deeds of obedience to Him.

And know that if Allah intends good for a servant, He opens his chest for Islam. So He grants that he will speak the truth by his tongue, and binds his heart to it so that he will act in accordance with it. If Allah does not intend good for a servant, He leaves him to himself — his chest becomes constricted and he becomes hypocritical before Allah. So fear Allah and ask Him to open your chests for Islam, that He make your tongues speak the truth until you die upon that, and that He make your return to be like the returning of the righteous ones before you. And know that the one who wishes to know whether Allah loves him should act in obedience to Allah and follow us. Have you not heard the words of Allah to His Prophet: 'Say: If you love Allah, then follow me, Allah will love you and forgive you your faults' [3:31]?

By Allah, no servant will be in obedience to Allah ever until Allah makes him included along with obedience to Him, obedience to us. And by Allah, no servant will be following us ever until Allah loves him. And by Allah, no servant leaves following us ever except that he hates us. And by Allah, no one hates us ever except that he disobeys Allah. And the one who dies whilst being in disobedience to Allah, Allah will disgrace him and fling him upon his face in the Fire.
And Praise is due to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
